properties.OutageReportInfo: NEWFOUNDLAND AND LABRADOR HYDRO IS ADVSING CUSTOMERS IN THE COMMUNITIES OF DANIELS HARBOUR AND PORTLAND CREEK OF AN UNPLANNED POWER OUTAGE.  HALF OF DANIELS HARBOUR AND ALL OF PORTLAND CREEK IS WITHOUT POWER. THE CREW IS ON ROUTE TO INVESTIGATE. THERE IS NO ESTIMATED TIME OF RESTORATION.
properties.Title: Under Investigation
